dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product asks people to find one value by typing: in a list too long to scan (a token among hundreds, a time zone, a person), or in a box that suggests values and also takes one of the person's own (a font family). The box is the same box as its text inputs and its selects; what is the combobox's own is the list it opens, drawn as its menus are, with the chosen option marked and the matched letters set apart, a status row for a list that arrives from a server while the person types, and the place of a clear button beside the chevron.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: What a combobox draws that is its own. The list: its surface, corners, lift, paddings, offset from the box, margin to the window's edge and greatest height; per density (regular, compact) an option's least height, paddings, gap, glyph and check sizes and a group title's inset; an option's corners, text styles and the weight of the matched letters; a group's title, the divider or the gap between groups; the status row; the motion of opening and closing and of a row's state change, and a row's opacity in each state; an option's colors at rest and chosen, in each state. And the gap between the clear button and the chevron. The box is comp.input-box.*.
rules: A combobox holds one value a person finds by typing. For a short closed list use a select; for a query that finds things to go to use the search; for actions use a menu.

A combobox is the bare box and its list: it has no label row, no requirement tag, no help and no error text. Put it in a Field for those, or use the combobox field, which is that pair; their tokens are comp.field.*.

The box — container, edges, floating label, typed text, placeholder, caret, selection, the chevron (trailing-icon), heights and paddings per size, and the colors of each look in each state — is comp.input-box.*, shared with the text input, the select, the number input and the color input. This group holds only the list, the status row and the clear button's gap.
No separate focus ring is drawn on the box. The active option shows the focus ring inside its row.
The chosen option is the quiet selection: selected-option.container.color under on-secondary-container content, always with the check.

option.state-layer.color and selected-option.state-layer.color are the colors the state layers mix into a row. motion.state-duration, motion.state-easing and the four opacity tokens are the rows'; the box has its own in comp.input-box.
The clear button is an icon-only Button of the text variant with Button's own tokens; container.action-gap is its distance from the chevron.
compact is for a tool used with a pointer, where rows are many and looked through often; touch always gets rows of the touch target. The density never changes a text style.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never fork the component.

action-gap.$description: Between the clear button and the chevron at the end of the container.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product sets the two things at the end of a combobox as one tight pair while the text keeps its distance from them: the space between the pair and the space before it are two decisions.

stacked.$description: The default look: a filled box with no edge at rest and no label of its own; focus and error draw a line inside the box's edge. The text input's stacked colors, part for part.

option.$description: An option's row that is not the chosen one. Declared under each variant because the state mechanism values parts per variant; the three hold the same values: a list does not change with the look of its field.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A row has no fill at rest; the list's surface shows through.

selected-option.$description: The chosen option's row: the quiet selection, with a check at the end of the row. The fill never shows the choice alone.

filled.$description: The label floats inside a tinted box with a bottom line: the text input's filled colors. Not shipped by the default system.

option.$description: An option's row that is not the chosen one. Declared under each variant because the state mechanism values parts per variant; the three hold the same values: a list does not change with the look of its field.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A row has no fill at rest; the list's surface shows through.

selected-option.$description: The chosen option's row: the quiet selection, with a check at the end of the row. The fill never shows the choice alone.

outlined.$description: The label floats onto a border: the text input's outlined colors. Not shipped by the default system.

option.$description: An option's row that is not the chosen one. Declared under each variant because the state mechanism values parts per variant; the three hold the same values: a list does not change with the look of its field.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A row has no fill at rest; the list's surface shows through.

selected-option.$description: The chosen option's row: the quiet selection, with a check at the end of the row. The fill never shows the choice alone.

state-duration.$description: How long colors and edge widths take to follow a change of state.

feedback-duration.$description: How long an option's ripple takes to grow.

open-duration.$description: How long the list takes to appear.

close-duration.$description: How long the list takes to go.

color.$description: The list's surface: the raised sheet a menu, a select's list and a popover are drawn on.

padding-block.$description: Inset above the first row and below the last.

padding-inline.$description: Inset at the sides of the rows. With an option's own padding it puts an option's label under the text in the input.

max-height.$description: The tallest the list grows before its rows scroll: six rows and most of a seventh at the default row height, so that a cut row shows there is more. The room left in the window limits it further.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product decides how much of a long list of matches it shows at once before the list scrolls, so that an open list does not cover the form it belongs to.

offset.$description: Distance between the container and the list.

viewport-margin.$description: The least distance the list keeps from the window's edges and from an on-screen keyboard.

height.$description: Minimum height of an option's row; the row grows with its text.

shape.$description: The corners of a row's highlight and of its state layer: the list's corner less the inset the rows stand at, so that the two curves keep one distance.

padding-inline.$description: Padding at each end of a row.

padding-block.$description: Padding above and below a row's text; also above and below a group's title and the status row.

gap.$description: Distance between a row's glyph, its text and its check.

typescale.$description: The line under an option's label.

size.$description: The glyph before an option's label.
The check at the end of the chosen option's row, and the box kept for it in every row.

emphasis.$description: How much weight the part of an option's label that matched the typed text gains, added to the weight of option.label.typescale. Weight alone: a match is not a selection, a choice or a link, so it takes no color.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product filters a long list as a person types and shows in each row why that row is still there; how heavy the matched letters are is its choice, and 0 marks nothing.

typescale.$description: The heading above a group's options.

padding-inline.$description: A title starts where the rows' content starts.

gap.$description: Under gap: the empty space between two groups. Not read under divider.

color.$description: The one hairline, between two groups under divider.

space.$description: Under divider: space above and below the line. Not read under gap.

separation.$description: How a group of options is told from what is next to it. divider: a line of divider.thickness in divider.color, with divider.space above and below it. gap: group.gap of empty space and no line. Follows the system's choice; a combobox's separation prop overrides it. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product parts the groups of its lists with a line, or by space, as it parts the groups of its menus; the list of a field must be able to leave the system-wide answer, as the menu can.

typescale.$description: The status row's text and the text shown when nothing matches.

color.$description: The status row's text while nothing is wrong, and the text shown when nothing matches: secondary to the options.
The status row's text while status is error. The words say what failed; the color says that something did.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product loads the options of some of its comboboxes while a person types and must say, in the list, that it is waiting, that it failed, or that nothing matched; how quiet that line is beside the options is its choice.
